Clustered Bootstrap CI for AUC

Source: R/bias-audit.R
os_clustered_bootstrap_auc.Rd

Bootstrap the AUC of a set of predictions respecting within-cluster dependence (e.g., duplicated specimens with the same internal ID across accessions; repeated measures from the same patient). Rows with the same cluster ID are resampled as a unit, which preserves the within-cluster correlation structure and prevents anti-conservative CIs.

Usage

os_clustered_bootstrap_auc(
  y,
  predictions,
  cluster_id,
  n_boot = 2000L,
  stratify_by = NULL,
  ci_type = c("two-sided", "one-sided-lower"),
  alpha = 0.05,
  seed = 42L
)

Arguments

y

Binary outcome vector.

predictions

Numeric predicted probabilities / scores.

cluster_id

Vector of cluster identifiers (length n).

n_boot

Number of bootstrap replicates. Default 2000.

stratify_by

Optional factor for stratified resampling (e.g., fold x class). Strata are preserved at the cluster level.

ci_type

One of "two-sided" or "one-sided-lower". Default "two-sided".

alpha

Significance level (default 0.05).

seed

Random seed.

Value

A list with the point AUC and bootstrap CI bounds.
